name: svg-mask-effect
title: SVG Mask Reveal
description: A white panel of bold statement text with a small black spotlight that tracks the pointer. Hovering opens the spotlight wide and darkens the panel to show a different sentence underneath.
use: A short statement should hide a second message that only appears under the cursor.
avoid: The hidden message must be readable on touch or keyboard, or the copy has to be discoverable.
a11y: The reveal is pointer-only with no keyboard or focus route, and the mask ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide white panel holding one block of large bold near-black text, a two-sentence rule with DO NOT in capitals, centred in the space. A tiny solid black dot, the spotlight mask, sits somewhere on the text, and in one frame the whole panel has shifted to pale grey.
behaves: A black circular mask follows the pointer across the copy, a small dot by default that only hints at a white-on-black layer beneath. Moving the pointer onto the text grows the circle very wide as the panel darkens to navy, uncovering that second sentence, and leaving shrinks it again.
customise: children is the hidden layer inside the mask and revealText is what shows at rest; size and revealSize set the dot and expanded diameter. The white, navy and black colours are hardcoded.
weight: light: Two text layers and one masked div whose position and size motion updates.
